engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Internal Communication Error with Satellite Digital Audio Radio Services (SDARS) Module
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Satellite Digital Audio Radio Services (SDARS) Module
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: North American Region (NAR) RNS510 with integrated SDARS:
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block 030/031 for the SDARS Serial Number. If the Serial Number is NOT shown and the Fault Code does NOT clear the RNS510 needs to be replaced because the Internal SDARS Module cannot be replaced separately.
